exposure: ultrasound-guided bilateral erector spinae plane block (ESPB)
Ultrasound-guided bilateral erector spinae plane block (ESPB)
cohort: 140 parturients undergoing elective cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia
finding: Ultrasound-guided bilateral erector spinae plane block (ESPB) provided superior postoperative analgesia and reduced opioid consumption compared to intrathecal morphine (ITM) in women undergoing elective cesarean delivery.
